prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1469; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover shows scraping, a cracked corner of the bumper cover, and a dented rear door skin consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. It is not fully clear whether every mark on the lower panels came from this impact, so those areas were checked closely against the photographs. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing and blending the door, and repairing the quarter panel. The labor hours submitted fit the work described. The invoices show no repeated charges for the same operation. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the file or from the owner's account.
